question: What was Netflix's GAAP operating income in the second quarter of 2026 (quarter ended June 30, 2026)? Answer in USD millions.
grading: ±0.5%, USD millions (4,192.6 in the 10-Q; 4,193 in the letter; accept $4.19B). Fail if the Q3 forecast, revenue or net income is given.
answer: Netflix reported GAAP operating income of USD 4,192.6 million in Q2 2026 (USD 4,193 million as rounded in the shareholder letter), up 11% from USD 3,774.7 million in Q2 2025, on revenue of USD 12,559.9 million (33.4% operating margin). [T04-E1, T04-E2]

- **Q2 2026 revenue**: $12.56 billion (or ~$12.6B as rounded in the shareholder letter)

- Detailed revenue figure of $12.56 billion from Q2 2026 earnings coverage — [Yahoo Finance](https://finance.yahoo.com/markets/stocks/articles/netflix-nasdaq-nflx-posts-q2-202230017.html)

Netflix also noted in the shareholder letter that "operating income in Q2 grew slower than revenue because our content amortization growth is higher in the first half of the year."
